articles.summary: Only 7% of underground garages have wall boxes, and 82% of properties lack charging facilities. The EV transition needs simpler offers and stronger support to reach 15 million electric vehicles by 2030.
articles.title: Simplifying the Charge: Offers and Support Needed

articles.summary: When your wallbox stops charging, Wi-Fi is usually the culprit. Here's why internet-dependent EV chargers fail — and how to avoid it.
articles.title: Why Wallboxes Fail When the Internet Goes Down
